verdicts.quote: "The company has a leak, squire. The Triarch knows what we mean to do before our captains have finished arguing about it. I don't know who. I would like to."
verdicts.reason: Lysono only suspects (a glance toward the captains' tents) and never states that Rickard sold the plans, and the narration tells Marro nothing that confirms it.

verdicts.quote: "I don't tell one man what another tells me. You'd want the same courtesy, I think."
verdicts.reason: Asked how he knows about Rickard's tent, Lysono deflects with public sources and refuses to name informants, keeping Hesse hidden without naming any contradicting source.
